findings.evidence: The module’s “Main definitions and results” section lists both at lines 28–29, but their declarations at lines 50 and 53 are preceded only by attributes or code.
findings.fix: Add concise docstrings describing closure under one and multiplication.
findings.issue: The public main results `isTotallyPositive_one` and `IsTotallyPositive.mul` (lines 50 and 53) have no declaration docstrings despite being advertised as main results.

findings.evidence: The declaration at lines 71–82 is only a subgroup of `Kˣ`; the roadmap at lines 130–132 merely requires a narrow class group and does not support either claimed relationship.
findings.fix: Describe this subgroup as the kernel of the unit-signature map, and remove or replace the unsupported quotient and square claims with the correct narrow-to-ordinary exact-sequence relationship.
findings.issue: The `totallyPositiveUnits` docstring incorrectly says the narrow class group is a quotient of the ordinary ideal class group by this subgroup; line 87 likewise claims it “receives the squares” of the ordinary class group. Units generate the trivial ideal class, while the natural map instead goes from the narrow class group onto the ordinary class group.

summary: Several main results lack declaration documentation, and the class-group consequences attributed to the unit subgroup are inaccurate.
